data.desc: Mammoth Energy Services, Inc. (NASDAQ: TUSK) is a growth-oriented company centered on an expanding aviation leasing platform. Through its rental services segment, Mammoth leases and sells aviation assets and rents heavy equipment used in construction and energy operations. The Company also provides fiber optic services to utility customers; natural sand proppant for hydraulic fracturing; workforce accommodations for projects in remote locations; and directional drilling services.
